title: Vietnamese-Style Grilled Pork with French Baguette
description: A fusion of French and Vietnamese flavors, this dish features grilled pork served in a crispy French baguette with pickled carrots and daikon.

ingredients.name: thit (Vietnamese-style pork sausage)
ingredients.notes: look for a pork sausage with a mix of spices and herbs

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: marinated and grilled for added flavor

ingredients.name: nuong (Vietnamese chili sauce)
ingredients.notes: adjust to taste for spice level

instructions: Marinate tofu in nuong and a pinch of salt for at least 30 minutes.
Grill thit and tofu until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Slice bun into 1-inch pieces and toast until crispy.
Assemble sandwiches by spreading nuong on bun, adding grilled thit and tofu, and topping with yellowed.
Garnish with chopped peanuts or peanut butter if using.
For a vegetarian option, omit the thit and add more tofu or other vegetables.
For a vegan option, replace nuong with a dairy-free alternative and use a vegan-friendly bun.
